facts.fact: 街道疯狂：Risha/Rath 奔 Thana basilica——翼兵如乌鸦丢人；Rath 的 torus 召新死之灵接住坠落者；Saya 在 Vakara 别墅带着六具骷髅卫兵。
facts.anchor: Samhara hummed urgently in Risha’s hands

facts.fact: 父女分歧：Rath 要保圣殿里的 Mortri 门（关闭数百年）——「We will not use unorthodox practices on lost souls...We will protect the portal at whatever cost」；Risha 主张另有他法。
facts.anchor: “We will not use unorthodox practices on lost souls.”

facts.fact: Revenants 同路：Natsumi（旧 Jas 部下）护民——「borrow some people from the necropolis」（=尸体）；Risha 准了（料到父亲会怒）；对 Jas：「Natsumi makes a better leader than you did. More self-control.」
抢先引灵归体：她抓住 city watch 卫兵的魂线——「I'm sorry...But we have need of you」——不是切断送 void 而是引回尚温的尸体；尸群起身灵活如生；Rath 惊退：「What are you doing?」
并肩杀敌：掷矛被镰打偏、Valentin 之力断敌肘——Valentin 冷评「Solarians...They were always my least favorite to torture. Too many zealous fools crying for their god」；Rath 骨针钉入敌太阳穴。
facts.anchor: “They were always my least favorite to torture.

facts.fact: 父训阻截：她欲割未死之灵，Rath 抓肩推开——「Stop this! This isn't what I taught you!」——旧羞耻被阳台之争的挫败盖过；她重申「We need to use any method we can to defeat them」。
神选猎手登场：重口音武士鼓掌降落（胸前符号异于同袍、血管流金）——「the Children of the Renounced should not be underestimated」；先以光刃割喉处决己方残员：「That was their task, which they have failed. I was sent for you。」

圣礼斧：Rath 骨针贯其心喉眼太阳能穴——不过是激怒（血金多于红）；双圣礼斧（the kind once used for sacraments）；一声炸响——斧劈入 Risha 胸（sternum/肋骨碎裂、血灌肺）——「And her heart— / slowing— / slowed— / stopped.」武士自爆成灰：「Our Lord will be so glad...that I have succeeded.」
